# dotPDN LLC

> > Paint.NET is a free, lightweight image editing software for Windows developed by dotPDN LLC as an accessible alternative to professional photo editors.

dotPDN LLC develops Paint.NET, a free and open-source raster graphics editor designed for Windows. The software provides essential image editing tools for casual users and professionals alike, positioned as a simpler alternative to Adobe Photoshop and other commercial photo editors.
